title: The Weight of the Crown
description: Assess the 'Burden of Responsibility'. Discover if leading others is growing you or crushing you.

questions.text: When my team fails at a task, my first internal thought is...

options.text: How do we fix this together?
I need to find out who messed up.
It's entirely my fault for being a bad leader.
I can't believe I'm stuck with these people.

questions.text: Making 'The Final Decision' on a high-stakes project feels...

options.text: Invigorating and clear.
Nerve-wracking but necessary.
Paralyzing; I procrastinate until it's too late.
Terrifying; I feel I'm going to ruin everyone's lives.

questions.text: I feel I have to be 'Perfect' to maintain authority and respect...

options.text: No, I'm okay with showing vulnerability.
A little bit.
Significantly.
Absolutely; if they see a crack, I'm finished.

insight_cloud.title: Leadership Isolation
insight_cloud.text: The higher you go, the fewer peers you have to talk to. This 'Leadership Isolation' can lead to 'Compensatory Narcissism' or 'Severe Anxiety'. Leaders need 'Safe Containers' outside of work where they don't have to have any answers.

questions.text: The boundary between 'Work Problems' and 'My Worth' is...

options.text: Very clear.
Sometimes blurry.
Very thin.
Non-existent; I am my job results.

questions.text: Do you feel like you are 'faking it' and everyone is about to find out you aren't a 'Real' leader?

options.text: No.
Occasionally.
Yes, I feel like a fraud every day.
Yes, I am a decorative mask with no substance.
